reason: The studio's type union and ASSET_CATEGORIES allowlist had no way to express or display a `friction` kind, so the artifact was invisible and the write was refused.
An existing coverage tool parses .tsx with ScriptKind.TS, so it silently under-counts assertions behind inline JSX props.
The repo-wide substitution mechanism used a non-unique placeholder token and performed incorrect writes into unrelated specs.
The build command re-declares and then closes the launching session's presence row, an incorrect write by an existing verb.
The spawned builders ended their turn before the work was complete, waiting for a notification that would never arrive.
Launching without the documented tsx loader yields a 500 whose message names a workspace package rather than the missing loader, misdirecting diagnosis.
`pnpm --filter ... test` exits 0 when no project matches, so the proof command cannot go red and the build halts at a phase no leaf is scoped to fix.
A deliberately fail-silent writer behind a .strict() shape drops every usage event without surfacing the parse failure anywhere.
A brief's negative-existence premise was true when written and expired via a concurrent sibling session; none of the 18 modes describes an expiring handed-down premise.
The coverage check ran but matched a test title rather than the contract's clauses, so it read 7/7 while most clauses were unasserted.
The gate orders check:declared after typecheck and the full test suite, so a ten-second fix costs a whole re-run.
The mirror-conformance check exists but registers only one of the mirrored routes, so it verifies only part of the surface it fences.
No claim or mutex exists for the friction queue at all, so concurrent adjudicator seats drained and overwrote it unrefused.
The check's V=0 ceiling is scoped per-repo rather than per-author, so an existing rung reds a session over a sibling's live edits.
An existing command fails to resolve the house @path convention and performs a destructive whole-record overwrite while reporting success.
The machine-scoped hook's behaviour is decided by whatever branch the host checkout sits on and by the platform's non-blocking failed-hook semantics.
Node/tsx module and CJS-ESM resolution walk up from the script's own directory, so a scratchpad-resident script cannot resolve workspace packages regardless of the repo's code.
The delivered sheet and its cells carry no record of the code state that produced them, so a two-variable comparison is indistinguishable from a one-variable one.
renderArcRollup's fixed ordering puts the only actionable section last, so truncation silently removes it while the render looks complete.
The AUTHOR_TEST turn budget in the existing build verb was too low for a trivially provable unit, halting twice with no promoted patch.
The probe ran but used growthNodeCount===0 as a proxy for an unchanged picture, admitting frames whose other visual inputs had changed.
The authoring session published a steering comparative without checking it against two artifacts already in the store, and nothing checks it at consumption.
The lifecycle rule reads only the increment log, so chip-carried work is invisible to the surface that decides closure.
An existing check reports a routine-looking staleness red while withholding the budget fact it already holds, making its own documented remedy wrong.
No edge, tag, or check exists that can detect a later ADR semantically falsifying an earlier one's build address.
The shell pipe holds stdout open so the harness timeout SIGTERMs the detached run — a shell and tool-timeout interaction, not repository code.
The check ran but asserted against the branch diff rather than the promise it stood for, so its verdict was about the wrong object.
No kind-agnostic or field-agnostic corpus text search exists, so the absence sweep the session needed cannot be performed at all.
The non-vacuity guard runs but measures opaque pixels, a quantity no prop change can move, so it passes over a picture missing its subject.
A Linux-CI rmdir race in temp-fixture teardown reds the job on branches touching nothing near it.
A hardcoded 30s page.goto budget with no override is a bad default for a cold vite transform, and the refusal names the page instead.
Bun is installed but absent from the shell PATH on the dev box, so the gate reds over the machine's configuration rather than any code.
The `uat run` path passes the observe runner raw, omitting the memoization its sibling already has, so one deterministic command is re-run per leg.
An existing probe observes only one credential path and its fix hint prescribes a retired, actively dangerous invariant.
The rerun comparison ran but validated only the git tree, so it confidently declared 'nothing was fixed' when the repair was a live-store write.
The instrument ran as a test and reported 9 pass on a call whose arguments were in the wrong slots, so the check passed while the measurement was wrong.
The rung's closing message offers only two remedies and omits the correct one, steering sessions toward tests that cannot pass or a permanent EQUIVALENT marker.
The driver's default committed-rung URL points at an asset not in the repo, so the published reproduce command 404s with a message naming neither file.
The rung is skip-capable but failed to take its skip branch on a fresh worktree, reddening the gate for branches it does not measure.
A flag interaction re-arms the fence that --discharged-by is documented to be exempt from, and the refusal prescribes minting a spurious second increment.
